current_review.handoff:
Added `poll_interval_seconds: 30` as a top-level key in `ralph.yaml` (line 8),
placed after `check_command` and before the worker/reviewer prompt templates.
Only file changed: `ralph.yaml`. The orchestrator (`orch-run.sh`) should read
this value to configure its polling interval instead of hardcoding 30 seconds.
No schema validation exists for ralph.yaml, so consumers must handle the field
being absent (fallback to 30) for backward compatibility with other repos.
